heading: Activities
items: Recreational racket sports (badminton or tennis), jogging and cycling.

I enjoy cycling and, while a student at Carleton U and when I worked retail, cycled daily, including in winter, as a means of transportation more than recreation. My fiancé and I have an Chevrolet Equinox EV which we use for camping and road trips.
Favourite genre is sci-fi and fantasy (i.e. new Star Trek, Star Wars, Orville, House of the Dragon, Doctor Who). I read sci-fi and non-fiction books.
I frequently watch sci-fi with my friends.
I daily try to keep up to date with current major world and local events.
I like to play video games, chess and board games.
